right.en: The chickadee puffs up its feathers.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Maya stand by a snowy door, bundled up in warm layers until they look round and puffy; on the right a chickadee sits on a branch puffed up into a round ball of feathers, the same round shape. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a calm winter sky band across the top, a snowy branch band through the middle, a deep snow band along the bottom.

left.en: Both sink deep into the snow.
left.es-MX: Las dos se hunden en la nieve.

right.en: The snowshoe hare hops on top.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Maya step into deep snow, sinking up to their knees; on the right a snowshoe hare hops lightly across the top of the same deep snow on its wide feet, in the same stepping pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a quiet sky band across the top, a band of snowy hills through the middle, a deep snowfield band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Nuna e Maya descem de trenó.
left.en: Nuna and Maya sled down the hill.
left.es-MX: Nuna y Maya bajan en trineo.

right.en: The polar bear cub slides on its belly.
right.es-MX: El osito polar baja de panza.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Maya ride a small wooden sled down a gentle snowy slope, leaning forward; on the right a polar bear cub slides down a snowy slope on its belly in the same forward lean. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a wide sky band across the top, a gentle slope band through the middle, a flat snow band along the bottom.

right.en: The horse rolls on its back.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Maya roll sideways across a snowy field, arms tucked in; on the right a horse rolls on its back in the snow with its legs in the air, in the same tumbling pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a fence and pine band through the middle, a snowy field band along the bottom.

right.pt-BR: A raposa cava uma toca inteira.
right.en: The arctic fox digs a whole den.
right.es-MX: El zorro ártico cava una madriguera.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Maya kneel and dig a small hole in the snow with their hands; on the right an arctic fox digs a deep den into a snowbank with its front paws, in the same digging pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Four horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a snowbank band, a snow band, a frozen ground band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: As duas marcham na neve alta.
left.es-MX: Las dos marchan en la nieve alta.

right.en: The moose steps high on long legs.
right.es-MX: El alce pasa con sus patas largas.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Maya march with high knees through deep snow; on the right a moose lifts its long legs high over deep snow in the same marching step. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a band of bare trees through the middle, a deep snow band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Nuna e Maya varrem o banco.
left.en: Nuna and Maya sweep the bench.
left.es-MX: Nuna y Maya barren la banca.

right.pt-BR: O bisão varre com a cabeça.

right.es-MX: El bisonte barre con la cabeza.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Maya brush snow off a park bench with big sweeping arms; on the right a bison swings its big head from side to side to sweep snow off the grass, in the same sweeping motion. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a band of snowy hills through the middle, a meadow band with a bench along the bottom.

right.pt-BR: O lobo uiva ainda mais alto.
right.es-MX: El lobo aúlla mucho más fuerte.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Maya sing with their heads tipped back and mouths open, little clouds of breath in the air; on the right a wolf sits in the snow and howls with its head tipped back, in the same singing pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: an evening sky band across the top, a pine forest band through the middle, a snowfield band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Nuna e Maya se escondem no forte.

left.es-MX: Nuna y Maya se esconden en el fuerte.

right.en: The lemming lives under the snow.
right.es-MX: El lemming vive bajo la nieve.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Maya peek over the low wall of a snow fort, only their eyes showing; on the right a lemming peeks out of its tunnel under the snow, only its eyes showing, in the same peeking pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Four horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a snow fort band, a snow surface band, a band of tunnels under the snow along the bottom.

right.en: The reindeer shakes from head to tail.
right.es-MX: El reno se sacude de pies a cabeza.

A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a cabin and pine band through the middle, a snowy yard band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Nuna e Maya tomam banho quentinho.

right.es-MX: El macaco se calienta en agua termal.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Maya sit in a warm bath with steam rising, only their heads and shoulders above the water; on the right a snow monkey sits in a steaming hot spring with snow all around, only its head and shoulders above the water, in the same soaking pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a snowy sky band across the top, a rocky steam band through the middle, a warm water band along the bottom.

left.en: Nuna and Maya fall asleep, snug.
left.es-MX: Nuna y Maya se duermen juntitas.

right.en: The musk oxen huddle close to sleep.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Maya sleep side by side under a thick quilt, cuddled close; on the right a small herd of shaggy musk oxen huddles close together in the snow with their eyes closed, in the same cuddled shape. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a night sky band across the top, an ice ridge band through the middle, a snow band along the bottom.

cover_scene: Nuna and Maya stand facing forward, smiling. A snowshoe hare, an arctic fox, and a lemur are scattered around them, looking up at the children.
